description: The DENlab collection publishes measurements from a rooftop photovoltaic installation on the lower EWI building at TU Delft. The provider describes 180 Shell RSM-70 panels, paired through NKF OK4E inverters. The metadata gives panel and inverter ratings of 70 and 100 watts and an aggregate inverter capacity of nine kilowatts. Observations are described at ten-second intervals and delivered as NetCDF. Coverage: Coverage is one rooftop site in Delft, Netherlands, from 8 June 2007 to 19 May 2008. The interval and equipment ratings are provider metadata. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: Panel ratings and aggregate inverter capacity are distinct quantities. No NetCDF file was read, and actual variable definitions and operating completeness remain unverified. Simulation uses include photovoltaic generation and equipment-capacity modelling. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
